budget_accounting.comparison_boundary: N is an inference particle budget, not equal wall time, physical scorer calls, or total computation. The study is not a compute-efficiency comparison against beam search or exhaustive enumeration.
budget_accounting.complete_program_evaluation_semantics: Each sampled slot is reported even when its score is served from the task-local deterministic cache.
excluded_from_N_but_reported: exact reference enumeration over every grammar program
exhaustive one-hole oracle candidate score lookups and rankings

cached_provider_audit.reason: One realized trajectory with seven state/hole responses cannot cover the many states reached across the frozen task/N/repetition grid; missing states would require a new provider call or an arbitrary fallback.

claim_boundary: The study can assess finite-sample calibration of this exact SMC implementation under this declared mechanical proposal oracle and these four finite tasks.
It cannot assess LLM proposal quality, provider variability, contamination, generalization to arbitrary programs, or wall-clock advantage.
Finite-grid slopes are descriptive and do not prove asymptotic convergence rates.
The three new tasks are developmental and non-blind, not a confirmatory benchmark.
Exact semantic multiplicity is task-dependent: zero-loss mass includes every grammar syntax that matches the public examples, not one privileged target AST.
The mechanical oracle exhaustively evaluates local repair candidates, so favorable estimator behavior does not imply search efficiency.

failure_policy.invalid_or_nonfinite_result: write a sealed failure artifact and abort
failure_policy.partial_output: retain as a sealed failed-closed artifact
failure_policy.reference_limit_exceeded: write a sealed failure artifact and abort

exact_target_mass: signed bias by task and N
target_mean_loss: signed bias by task and N

primary_gate.population: pooled over all 4 tasks x 32 repetitions

proposal_distribution.importance_correction: exact application-computed q; the oracle supplies no probability
proposal_distribution.recursive_grammar_prior: g is the frozen normalized rule-factorized grammar prior

proposal_oracle.candidate_support: every non-no-op grammar expression for the selected predicate or mapper hole
proposal_oracle.important_boundary: This is an explicitly idealized mechanical proposal oracle, not an LLM and not a provider-cache replay.
ranking_lexicographic: complete-program loss on all public examples
proposal_oracle.repair_hole: mechanical evidence-based hole selection with the frozen alternate-hole stall policy

purpose: Measure finite-sample error of the evidence-shortlist SMC estimator against exact finite-grammar references under a deterministic, provider-free proposal oracle.

stage_targets.1: recursive grammar prior times exp(-2 * predicate singleton violations)
stage_targets.2: recursive grammar prior times exp(-2 * (predicate+mapper singleton violations))
stage_targets.3: recursive grammar prior times exp(-(predicate+mapper singleton violations) + scorer.log_target/2)

tasks.new_tasks: three hand-constructed tasks were created before calibration outcomes were observed
tasks.public_evidence: Each task includes empty, singleton, ordered, permuted, and repeated-item examples.
tasks.reused_task: foldr-bounded-square is the earlier developmental bounded task
tasks.shared_grammar: 600 predicate syntaxes x 60 mapper syntaxes = 36000 complete program syntaxes
tasks.target_programs_not_stored: Targets are documented only in tests for task-fixture validation; the runtime oracle reads only public task examples and grammar catalogs.
